_what: A job may carry a time budget (hand_off time_budget_seconds): the seconds its attempts may hold it in all. When the attempts that ended have used it, the job stops with a typed stop (blocked_kind time_budget) and stays stopped until someone takes it by name, like a job that ran out of attempts. `stays_stopped` lists the stop kinds Trillion itself sets that wait for someone to take the job by name. Money budgets are the spending owner's.

words.stopped: Its attempts have held it for {used} of the {budget} seconds it was given.
words.recovery: Take it again by its handoff_id to give it more time, or hand the job to another AI.
